'''Ralia Lok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] of [[Clan Lok]] who [[Eternal Empire conquest|fought]] against the [[Eternal Empire]] when they invaded [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and witnessed the [[Death/Legends|death]] of her leader [[Mandalore the Vindicated]] at the hands of enemy [[Skytrooper]]s.

==Biography==
Ralia Lok was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] of [[Clan Lok]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The [[Eternal Empire]] invaded [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="Codex" /> in [[3636 BBY]], and at some point in the next [[3631 BBY|five]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|4.0}}</ref> Ralia was fighting alongside her clan against the Eternal Empire's [[Droid/Legends|robotic]] [[Skytrooper]]s when they found themselves overwhelmed and cornered by two dozen Skytroopers.<ref name="Codex" />

The Mandalorians were saved by the arrival of [[Mandalore the Vindicated]], who tore through the Skytrooper lines and ordered the surviving warriors to regroup with the rest of Clan Lok; however, he was overwhelmed by Skytrooper reinforcements and [[Death/Legends|sacrificed]] his life to ensure the safety of Ralia and the others. Ralia attempted to rush to his aid but was stopped by her clan brother [[Droga]], who pointed out that the [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]] was already gone. In her recording of the battle, she cursed the fact that her leader had been killed dishonorably by machines instead of other warriors and prayed to the [[God/Legends|god]] ''[[Kad Ha'rangir]]'' for the war's end.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ralia Lok was mentioned in the Codex entry "The Fall of Mandalore the Vindicated" in Chapter XIV of [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']], a [[2015]] Digital Expansion to the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
